links.comparator_used: Naive XGBoost model trained without unfairness mitigation (best naive model), compared against 3 algorithm unfairness mitigation techniques
links.outcome: Model fairness measured by equalized odds ratio (eOR) across sex and racial subgroups, with F1-score as the performance metric
links.effect: Naive XGBoost: F1 0.860, eOR 0.619. All mitigation techniques increased eOR; correlation remover gave the highest, final eOR 0.750. Mitigated model F1 was 0.86 in the full test set, 0.904 in Black male and 0.824 in Asian female test sets.
links.quote: All unfairness mitigation techniques increased the eOR, with correlation remover showing the highest increase and resulting in a final eOR of 0.750.

design_hint: algorithmic unfairness mitigation (bias evaluation and mitigation techniques)
